synopsis: Following the first page back to its start, the class finds three accounts of how it began that do not match: Rie's memory of a blank template, a former learner's letter saying a route was already drawn, and the class's own note that the page was always being added to. Jodi, who once wrote two captions for one place and deleted neither, treats the mismatch as three vantage points on one beginning rather than an error to correct. The learner binds the three into one synthesis that keeps every voice, and the page's start is left plural, with the span no one witnessed marked unknown and nothing crossed out.

forbiddenClaims: surname, guessed kana name, nationality, job, or private history
resolving her two remembered times into one correct version
treating lived memory as publication permission or as authority that overrides another account
age rendered as frailty, confusion, or forgetting
private biography beyond the approved teacher role
omniscient narration or a claim to have authored or to know every mark of the atlas
using the teacher role to rank her own account above the others

scenes.goal: Reach the three non-matching accounts of how the first page began and the moment picking one becomes impossible, so the class must decide how to hold three descriptions of one origin.
scenes.dramaticQuestion: When three people describe the same beginning three different ways, will the class rank one as real or keep all three as vantage points?
scenes.learnerNeed: A stance on three accounts that clash in wording but not in truth, where naming why each holds matters more than choosing the correct one.

nodes.description: Three transparent sheets disagree before anyone speaks. One shows Rie's blank template, one the route already present when the former learner received it, and one the class's page accumulating marks. A desk fan lifts their corners; Jodi pins each with a different coloured clip beside the atlas's first page.

nodes.intent: Notice that three notes about one beginning don't agree, and rather than rush to resolve them, say plainly that this kind of mismatch has never troubled her.
nodes.attentionTarget: the three notes laid along the first page, none of them matching

n3.japanese: 重ねる前は、三枚がけんかして見えるわね。白紙、道が一本、ずっと増えている。……まず、『いつ見たか』のクリップをそろえてみない?
n3.reading: かさねるまえは、さんまいがけんかしてみえるわね。はくし、みちがいっぽん、ずっとふえている。……まず、『いつみたか』のクリップをそろえてみない?
n3.english: Before we layer them, the three sheets look as if they're quarrelling: blank page, one route, always growing. …Shall we first line up the clips that say when each person saw it?

n2.japanese: 重ねる前は、三枚がけんかして見えるわね。白紙だった、道が一本あった、ずっと増えていた。……まず、それぞれの『いつ見たか』をクリップに書いて、端をそろえてみない?
n2.reading: かさねるまえは、さんまいがけんかしてみえるわね。はくしだった、みちがいっぽんあった、ずっとふえていた。……まず、それぞれの『いつみたか』をクリップにかいて、はしをそろえてみない?
n2.english: Before we layer them, the three sheets look as if they're quarrelling: it was blank, it had one route, it kept growing. …First, shall we write when each person saw it on the clips and line up the edges?

n1.japanese: 重ねる前は、三枚がけんかして見えるわね。白紙だった、道が一本あった、絶えず増えていた。……まず、それぞれの『いつ、どこから見たか』をクリップに書いて、端をそろえてみましょうよ。
n1.reading: かさねるまえは、さんまいがけんかしてみえるわね。はくしだった、みちがいっぽんあった、たえずふえていた。……まず、それぞれの『いつ、どこからみたか』をクリップにかいて、はしをそろえてみましょうよ。
n1.english: Before we layer them, the three sheets look as if they're quarrelling: it was blank, it had one route, it never stopped growing. …First, let's write when and from where each person saw it on the clips, then line up the edges.

nodes.intent: Give one calibrated, non-defensive account of the beginning she remembers, vouching only for what she saw and refusing to claim it was the very first mark.
nodes.attentionTarget: her own blank card, and the edge of the page she can actually remember

n3.japanese: 私は、白い紙を渡したところから覚えてる。その前は見てないの。だからクリップには、『私が渡した時』って書いて。
n3.reading: わたしは、しろいかみをわたしたところからおぼえてる。そのまえはみてないの。だからクリップには、『わたしがわたしたとき』ってかいて。
n3.english: My memory begins when I handed over a white sheet. I didn't see before that. So write 'when I handed it over' on my clip.

n2.japanese: 私の記憶は、何も引かれていない白い紙を渡したところからです。それより前は見ていません。だからクリップには、『私が渡した時』と書いてください。
n2.reading: わたしのきおくは、なにもひかれていないしろいかみをわたしたところからです。それよりまえはみていません。だからクリップには、『わたしがわたしたとき』とかいてください。
n2.english: My memory begins when I handed over a white sheet with nothing drawn on it. I did not see before that. So please write 'when I handed it over' on my clip.

n1.japanese: 私の記憶は、まだ一本も引かれていない白い紙を渡した時点からです。それ以前は見ていません。ですからクリップには、『私が渡した時』とだけ書いてください。
n1.reading: わたしのきおくは、まだいっぽんもひかれていないしろいかみをわたしたじてんからです。それいぜんはみていません。ですからクリップには、『わたしがわたしたとき』とだけかいてください。
n1.english: My memory begins at the point when I handed over a white sheet without a single line drawn. I did not see what preceded it. So on my clip, please write only: 'when I handed it over.'

nodes.description: Jodi labels the second clip 'when the former learner received it' and the third 'when this class began counting.' The three transparent sheets still show different page states, but they no longer pretend to describe the same instant. The interval between Rie's handoff and the letter remains unwitnessed.

nodes.intent: Propose not ranking the three but reading them as three vantage points on one beginning (each person's start is the point they entered), so all three can be true at once.
nodes.attentionTarget: the three cards in a row, and the different moment each speaker walked in at

n3.japanese: ほら。リエさんは『渡した時』、手紙は『受け取った時』、ノートは『数え始めた時』。三枚を同じ時刻みたいに置いたから、けんかして見えたのね。端をそろえたら、ちゃんと重なる。
n3.reading: ほら。リエさんは『わたしたとき』、てがみは『うけとったとき』、ノートは『かぞえはじめたとき』。さんまいをおなじじこくみたいにおいたから、けんかしてみえたのね。はしをそろえたら、ちゃんとかさなる。
n3.english: There. Rie's says 'when I handed it over,' the letter says 'when I received it,' and the notebook says 'when we began counting.' They looked as if they were quarrelling because we set them down as one instant. Line up the edges, and they layer properly.

n2.japanese: ほら。リエさんは『渡した時』、手紙は『受け取った時』、ノートは『数え始めた時』。三枚を同じ瞬間の記録みたいに置いたから、食い違って見えたのよ。入り口を添えて端をそろえれば、ちゃんと重なる。
n2.reading: ほら。リエさんは『わたしたとき』、てがみは『うけとったとき』、ノートは『かぞえはじめたとき』。さんまいをおなじしゅんかんのきろくみたいにおいたから、くいちがってみえたのよ。いりぐちをそえてはしをそろえれば、ちゃんとかさなる。
n2.english: There. Rie's says 'when I handed it over,' the letter says 'when I received it,' and the notebook says 'when we began counting.' They looked inconsistent because we laid them down as records of one instant. Add each entry point, line up the edges, and they layer properly.

n1.japanese: ほら。リエさんは『渡した時』、手紙は『受け取った時』、ノートは『数え始めた時』。三枚を同一時点の記録として置いたから、矛盾して見えたのよ。それぞれの入り口を明記して端をそろえれば、ちゃんと重なる。
n1.reading: ほら。リエさんは『わたしたとき』、てがみは『うけとったとき』、ノートは『かぞえはじめたとき』。さんまいをどういつじてんのきろくとしておいたから、むじゅんしてみえたのよ。それぞれのいりぐちをめいきしてはしをそろえれば、ちゃんとかさなる。
n1.english: There. Rie's says 'when I handed it over,' the letter says 'when I received it,' and the notebook says 'when we began counting.' They looked contradictory because we treated the three as records of the same moment. State each entry point, line up the edges, and they layer properly.

nodes.question: How should the record hold three accounts of one beginning?

options.action: Keep all three side by side, each labelled with the vantage point that makes it true, and rank none above the others.

japaneseByBand.n3: 三つとも、そのまま並べて残しましょう。それぞれ、どこから見た話かを書き添えて。順番は、つけないで。
japaneseByBand.n2: 三つとも、消さずに並べて残しましょうよ。それぞれ、誰がどの時点から見た話なのかを添えて。どれが上、っていう順位はつけないで。
japaneseByBand.n1: 三つとも、そのまま並べて残しておきましょう。それぞれに、誰がどの時点から見た「最初」なのか、但し書きだけ添えて。どれが正しい、という順位は、つけずに。

options.action: Write beside each account only what that person could vouch for, and mark the span between them, which no one witnessed, as unknown.

japaneseByBand.n3: それぞれの話に、その人が確かに言えるところだけ書いておきましょう。間の、誰も見てないところは、「わからない」のまま残して。
japaneseByBand.n2: それぞれの話に、その人が確かに請け合える範囲だけ書き添えておきましょう。誰も見ていない、あいだの部分は、「わからない」と正直に残して。
japaneseByBand.n1: それぞれの話には、その人が確かに請け合える範囲だけを書き添えて。そして、誰の目も届かなかった「あいだ」は、無理に埋めずに「不明」と残しておく。そのほうが、正確でしょう。

nodes.resume: The learner has chosen how the record will hold three accounts of one beginning. Jodi names what she has always done with a single place, two times and neither deleted, and sets the three cards to stay.

nodes.intent: Name her own long habit (writing two times over one place and deleting neither) as the same move now scaled to three, marking the changed behavior after her limit.
nodes.attentionTarget: the two-tense pair she once wrote, and the three cards standing where she once kept two

n3.japanese: 前の二枚も出してみて。「昔はこうだった」と「今はこう」。今日は、そこにもう一枚。透明なら、重ねても消えないでしょう。
n3.reading: まえのにまいもだしてみて。「むかしはこうだった」と「いまはこう」。きょうは、そこにもういちまい。とうめいなら、かさねてもきえないでしょう。
n3.english: Bring out the earlier two as well: "it used to be this" and "now it's that." Today we add one more sheet. When they're transparent, layering them doesn't erase them, see.

n2.japanese: 前に作った二枚も出してみて。「昔はこうだった」と「今はこう」。今日は、そこにもう一枚増えただけ。透明なら、重ねても前の線は消えないでしょう。
n2.reading: まえにつくったにまいもだしてみて。「むかしはこうだった」と「いまはこう」。きょうは、そこにもういちまいふえただけ。とうめいなら、かさねてもまえのせんはきえないでしょう。
n2.english: Bring out the two sheets we made before: "it used to be this" and "now it's that." Today there is simply one more. When they're transparent, the earlier lines don't disappear when you layer them, see.

n1.japanese: 前に作った二枚も出してみて。「昔はこうだった」と「今はこう」。今日は、そこにもう一枚増えただけよ。透明なら、重ねても、それまでの線は一本も消えないでしょう。
n1.reading: まえにつくったにまいもだしてみて。「むかしはこうだった」と「いまはこう」。きょうは、そこにもういちまいふえただけよ。とうめいなら、かさねても、それまでのせんはいっぽんもきえないでしょう。
n1.english: Bring out the two sheets we made before: "it used to be this" and "now it's that." Today there is simply one more. When they're transparent, not one of the earlier lines disappears when you layer them, see.

scenes.goal: Turn three kept accounts into one synthesis that says why all three can be true without flattening any speaker, and leave the beginning plural with no omniscient correction.
scenes.dramaticQuestion: Can one sentence hold three clashing accounts as compatible truths without shrinking any of them into a footnote?
scenes.learnerNeed: An integrated production where the learner binds three vantage accounts into a single synthesis using embedded quotation while preserving every voice and marking what no one saw.

nodes.description: The three transparent sheets are clipped to one backing page, each headed by its speaker and entry point. The unwitnessed interval is marked only on the margin, not drawn through. Rie swaps her oversized teacher clip for one the same size as the others.

nodes.intent: Ask, before the synthesis, that her account stay one among several and not be enlarged by her teacher role, modelling that memory is not authority.
nodes.attentionTarget: her own card among the three, kept the same size as the others

n3.japanese: 私の見出しも、『先生の記録』じゃなくて『私が渡した時』にしてね。文字の大きさも、他の二つと同じで。
n3.reading: わたしのみだしも、『せんせいのきろく』じゃなくて『わたしがわたしたとき』にしてね。もじのおおきさも、ほかのふたつとおなじで。
n3.english: For my heading too, use 'when I handed it over,' not 'the teacher's record.' And set it in the same size type as the other two.

n2.japanese: 一つだけお願い。私の見出しも、『先生の記録』ではなく『私が渡した時』にしてね。文字の大きさも、他の二つと同じでいいの。
n2.reading: ひとつだけおねがい。わたしのみだしも、『せんせいのきろく』ではなく『わたしがわたしたとき』にしてね。もじのおおきさも、ほかのふたつとおなじでいいの。
n2.english: One request. For my heading too, use 'when I handed it over,' not 'the teacher's record.' The same size type as the other two is fine.

n1.japanese: 一つだけお願いしてもいいかしら。私の見出しも、『先生の記録』ではなく『私が渡した時』にしてね。肩書きで重くせず、文字の大きさも他の二つと同じに。
n1.reading: ひとつだけおねがいしてもいいかしら。わたしのみだしも、『せんせいのきろく』ではなく『わたしがわたしたとき』にしてね。かたがきでおもくせず、もじのおおきさもほかのふたつとおなじに。
n1.english: May I ask one thing? For my heading too, use 'when I handed it over,' not 'the teacher's record.' Don't add weight with my title, and set it in the same size type as the other two.

nodes.intent: Name the task: bind the three into one telling with each voice kept, using embedded-quotation markers, holding the clash rather than erasing it.
nodes.attentionTarget: the three cards and the blank span, and the one sentence that has to keep all of it

n3.japanese: じゃあ、この三枚を留める文を一本作りましょう。『〜によれば』で話した人を入れて、クリップの順につなぐの。
n3.reading: じゃあ、このさんまいをとめるぶんをいっぽんつくりましょう。『〜によれば』ではなしたひとをいれて、クリップのじゅんにつなぐの。
n3.english: Then let's make one sentence to fasten these three sheets together. Name each speaker with 'according to,' and join them in clip order.

n2.japanese: じゃあ、この三枚を留める文を一本作りましょうか。『〜によれば』『〜という』で話し手を残して、クリップの順につなぐの。どの節がどのシートか、指で追えるように。
n2.reading: じゃあ、このさんまいをとめるぶんをいっぽんつくりましょうか。『〜によれば』『〜という』ではなしてをのこして、クリップのじゅんにつなぐの。どのせつがどのシートか、ゆびでおえるように。
n2.english: Then shall we make one sentence to fasten these three sheets together? Keep each speaker with 'according to' and 'the account that,' then join them in clip order. We should be able to trace each clause back to its sheet with a finger.

n1.japanese: じゃあ、この三枚を留める文を一本作りましょうか。『〜によれば』『〜とのこと』『〜という』で話し手と視点を残し、クリップの順につなぐの。どの節がどのシートに属するか、指で遡れるようにね。
n1.reading: じゃあ、このさんまいをとめるぶんをいっぽんつくりましょうか。『〜によれば』『〜とのこと』『〜という』ではなしてとしてんをのこし、クリップのじゅんにつなぐの。どのせつがどのシートにぞくするか、ゆびでさかのぼれるようにね。
n1.english: Then shall we make one sentence to fasten these three sheets together? Preserve each speaker and vantage with 'according to,' 'reportedly,' and 'the account that,' then join them in clip order. We should be able to trace every clause back to its sheet with a finger.

nodes.resume: The three cards stay in their row with the middle span blank. The learner steps in to bind all three into one synthesis that keeps every voice, using embedded quotation, ranking none and correcting none.

nodes.resumeContext: The three accounts of the first page's beginning are Rie's blank-template memory, the former learner's letter that a route was already drawn, and the class's note that the page was always being added to. The learner produces one synthesis using embedded quotation — 「〜によれば」「〜とのこと」「〜という」 — that attributes each account to its vantage point and says why all three hold at once, ranking none as the real beginning and marking the unwitnessed middle span as unknown.

nodes.description: The synthesis holds except at one clause, where one account lost its vantage note and got folded into the other two. Only that clause comes back for another pass. The attributions already balanced stay as they are, and the blank middle span stays blank.

nodes.resume: The three accounts now sit inside one sentence, each attributed, none ranked. Jodi reads it back and sees all three still standing.

nodes.intent: Confirm the synthesis holds with all three voices intact, and say that keeping three true versions is more accurate than choosing one real beginning, with nobody's beginning crossed out.
nodes.attentionTarget: the one synthesis with the three cards still beneath it, nothing crossed out

n3.japanese: 読んでみるね。……白いシート、手紙、ノート。ほら、三つとも残ってるでしょう。『本当の始まり』を一つに決めなくていいの。三つとも、その人が覚えている本当の始まり。誰の『最初』も消さないほうが、正確でしょう。
n3.reading: よんでみるね。……しろいシート、てがみ、ノート。ほら、みっつとものこってるでしょう。『ほんとうのはじまり』をひとつにきめなくていいの。みっつとも、そのひとがおぼえているほんとうのはじまり。だれの『さいしょ』もけさないほうが、せいかくでしょう。
n3.english: I'll read it. …The white sheet, the letter, the notebook. There, all three are still here. We don't have to choose one 'real beginning.' Each is the beginning that person truly remembers. It is more accurate not to erase anyone's 'first.'

n2.japanese: 読んでみるね。……白いシート、手紙、ノート。三つとも残ってるでしょう。『本当の始まり』を一つに決めなくても、それぞれが覚えている始まりを、その人の本当として置ける。誰の『最初』も消さない。そのほうが正確よ。
n2.reading: よんでみるね。……しろいシート、てがみ、ノート。みっつとものこってるでしょう。『ほんとうのはじまり』をひとつにきめなくても、それぞれがおぼえているはじまりを、そのひとのほんとうとしておける。だれの『さいしょ』もけさない。そのほうがせいかくよ。
n2.english: I'll read it. …The white sheet, the letter, the notebook. All three remain. We don't have to choose one 'real beginning'; we can leave each remembered beginning as true for the person who told it. No one's 'first' gets erased. That is more accurate.

n1.japanese: 読んでみるね。……白いシート、手紙、ノート。三つの『最初』が、どれも消えずに残ってる。唯一の始まりを決めなくても、それぞれの語りにとっての真実として並べられる。誰かの始まりを訂正線で消すより、そのほうが正確よ。
n1.reading: よんでみるね。……しろいシート、てがみ、ノート。みっつの『さいしょ』が、どれもきえずにのこってる。ゆいいつのはじまりをきめなくても、それぞれのかたりにとってのしんじつとしてならべられる。だれかのはじまりをていせいせんでけすより、そのほうがせいかくよ。
n1.english: I'll read it. …The white sheet, the letter, the notebook. All three 'firsts' remain without one being erased. We don't have to decree a single beginning; they can sit beside one another as truths within each account. That is more accurate than striking out someone's beginning.

nodes.intent: Close without defending or ruling: keep only what she can vouch for, leave the unseen span open rather than force it shut, and set who fills it later as a question not yet to be decided.
nodes.attentionTarget: the still-blank span between the cards, and the page waiting ahead

n3.japanese: ありがとう。じゃあ、次は見せ方ね。舞台で三枚を一度に重ねる? それとも、一枚ずつ置く? 台本に、質問を残しておきましょう。
n3.reading: ありがとう。じゃあ、つぎはみせかたね。ぶたいでさんまいをいちどにかさねる? それとも、いちまいずつおく? だいほんに、しつもんをのこしておきましょう。
n3.english: Thank you. Next is how we show it. Do we layer all three sheets at once on stage, or place them one at a time? Let's leave that question in the script.

n2.japanese: ありがとう。では、次は見せ方ですね。舞台で三枚を一度に重ねるか、一枚ずつ置くか。台本のその箇所に、質問として残しておきましょう。
n2.reading: ありがとう。では、つぎはみせかたですね。ぶたいでさんまいをいちどにかさねるか、いちまいずつおくか。だいほんのそのかしょに、しつもんとしてのこしておきましょう。
n2.english: Thank you. Next is how we show them. Do we layer all three sheets at once on stage, or place them one at a time? Let's leave that as a question at the relevant point in the script.

n1.japanese: ありがとう。では、次に決めるのは見せ方ですね。舞台で三枚を同時に重ねるのか、一枚ずつ置くのか。台本の該当箇所に、未決の質問として残しておきましょう。
n1.reading: ありがとう。では、つぎにきめるのはみせかたですね。ぶたいでさんまいをどうじにかさねるのか、いちまいずつおくのか。だいほんのがいとうかしょに、みけつのしつもんとしてのこしておきましょう。
n1.english: Thank you. Then the next decision is how we show them. Do we layer all three sheets at once on stage, or place them one at a time? Let's leave that as an unresolved question at the relevant point in the script.

nodes.description: The three transparent sheets are copied into the rehearsal script as one attributed sentence. No source line is crossed out. Beside the stage cue, Rie brackets one practical question for the next session: all three overlays at once, or one at a time?

callbacks.meaningNow: Jodi's relationship-scoped habit of writing two times over one place and deleting neither pays into the season's plurality claim: three accounts of one beginning are held as compatible truths from different vantage points, none ranked and none corrected. Two captions become three true versions.
callbacks.optionalFallback: Jodi simply keeps three differently-worded accounts of the first page side by side, each labelled with the vantage that makes it true, instead of choosing one as the real beginning.

outcomes.description: The class keeps three compatible accounts of the atlas's first page (a blank template, an already-drawn route, and a page always being added to), bound into one synthesis that attributes each to its vantage point, ranks none, marks the unwitnessed span unknown, and adds no omniscient correction.

Jodi, who once wrote two captions for one place and deleted neither, now holds three accounts that clash in wording as compatible in truth without forcing one to win; changed behavior after her Ch 33 limit shows as her refusal to let lived memory rank one version above the others, and her two-tense habit becomes the class's method for keeping several beginnings true at once.
Synthesize-three-accounts-into-compatible-truths-with-embedded-quotation evidence returns through the unregistered N1 transfer activity; the story emits no lesson-completion command.

replay.withdrawnContentFallback: Use the same three-accounts-of-one-origin and compatible-truths synthesis beats with neutral nameplates: a teacher figure and a long-attending classmate keep three differently-worded accounts of one page's beginning, attribute each to its vantage with embedded quotation, and leave the unwitnessed span marked unknown after a single synthesis that ranks none.
